title: How to use RNExchange (Trader)
subtitle: A guide to trading in the RNExchange simulator
introduction: Welcome to RNExchange! This is a simulated trading environment designed for educational purposes. All trades, balances, and positions are simulated — this is NOT real money.

responsibilities.title: Your Responsibilities as a Trader
items: Manage your watchlist of instruments to monitor
Track your positions and portfolio performance
Review your ledger and daily statements
Monitor your buying power and account balance

items.name: Market Watch
items.description: View live market data, add instruments to your watchlist, and place orders

items.name: Portfolio
items.description: See your open positions, unrealized P&L, and portfolio summary

items.name: Ledger
items.description: View all cash movements, trade settlements, and running balance

items.name: Statements
items.description: Access daily statements showing opening/closing balances and P&L

items.title: Add to Watchlist
items.description: Go to Market Watch, search for an instrument (e.g., RELIANCE on NSE), and add it to your watchlist

items.title: Place a Market Order
items.description: Select an instrument from your watchlist, choose Buy or Sell, enter quantity, and submit a market order

items.title: Monitor Execution
items.description: Watch your order fill in real-time. Your position and cash balance will update automatically

items.title: View Portfolio
items.description: Navigate to Portfolio to see your updated positions, unrealized P&L, and total portfolio value

items.title: Check Ledger
items.description: Review your Ledger to see the cash movement from the trade, including any fees

items.title: Review Statements
items.description: After end-of-day processing, access your daily statement to see opening/closing balances and P&L

demoUsers.title: Demo Users
demoUsers.description: For testing and demos, use the trader_demo account. This account has a starting balance and can be reset between demo sessions.

disclaimer: Remember: RNExchange is a simulated environment. All trading activity is for educational purposes only. This is NOT real money or real trading.
